newsitem.title: USA: Federal Mogul sells Australian unit.
newsitem.headline: Federal Mogul sells Australian unit.

text.p: Federal-Mogul Corp said Wednesday it has agreed to sell its $50 million-a-year Australian aftermarket parts operations to Automotive Components Ltd for an undisclosed sum.
The Australian unit employs about 200 people and includes seven retail stores and six wholesale warehouses located in Adelaide, Brisbane, Melbourne, Newcastle, Perth, and Sydney.

Automotive Components, based in Victoria, Australia, also has entered into supply and distribution agreements with Federal-Mogul for the Australian and New Zealand automotive replacement parts markets.
"This sale is another significant step towards the successful completion of our restructuring objectives," Federal-Mogul Chairman Dick Snell said in a statement.
"We are also very pleased to be working with ACL as they are committed to growing the business and the sale of Federal-Mogul branded products in these markets."
Automotive Components, a major Australian automotive parts manufacturer, has annual sales of approximately $100 million and 1,050 employees.
Completion of the sale is subject to various conditions and is expected to be completed in the second quarter.
